visible.author: Moneypit
visible.title: Happy with purchase
visible.body: First, Livernois has great and very responsive customer service. If you get lost along the way, they will help you find your way. Second, the MyCalibrator is simple to download the needed tune information and very easy to install the tune. Dislikes: No manual included for other features. Difficult to determine if the truck has learned the tune. I installed with this Tune, the Livernois intercooler, but temps appear to be the same or a tad bit warmer.
visible.product: Livernois Motorsports MyCalibrator Touch Tuner (21-22 5.0L F-150)

visible.title: Perfect Tune!
visible.body: Very straight forward process working with Livernois to get the requested tunes. Took no time at all to load and wow! Right out of gate was a noticeable difference in throttle response, much improved turbo lag, and hit 20-21psi boost at full throttle! I did receive a TCM tune as well, so it took a little “normal” driving for it relearn and shift solid. Breaks my 35” tires loose in 2WD!
visible.product: Livernois Motorsports MyCalibrator Touch Tuner (17-20 3.5L EcoBoost F-150, Excluding Raptor)

visible.author: GeorgeLC
visible.title: Not usable as is
visible.body: So the description/ photo is a bit misleading. For me at least, I received an updated version of the my calibrator, which is isn’t a big deal, but should be updated nonetheless. Second, and more importantly is what isn’t stated; if you have a 19/20 Silverado with a E90 ECM, the ECM must be unlocked before this tuner can be used. In their fitment page it clearly states it will work with a 2020 custom trail boss - 5.3L / 6 speed automatic, which is what I have. No mention is made of checking it the ECM. Otherwise, livernois has been fairly quick so far with replying to my emails, so no real complaints there.
visible.product: Livernois Motorsports MyCalibrator Touch Tuner (14-20 5.3L Silverado 1500)

visible.author: NowayJose
visible.title: Wow
visible.body: Very easy to use. Not very quick to install initially but easy. Mostly just need to wait for the tune to be sent back but patience has never been a virtue for me. Noticeable gains that are worth every penny.
visible.product: Livernois Motorsports MyCalibrator Touch Tuner (21-22 5.0L F-150)

visible.author: jbowden
visible.title: Wish I would have bought sooner!
visible.body: I got the 91 octane tunes both for a performance tune and an economy/tow tune, with a cold air intake and a catback exhaust. I drive a 2011 F150 with the 3.5L ecoboost. Was pretty straightforward to install (although instructions could use some updates). Once the tunes are downloaded to the tuner, it’s quick and easy to install. Truck is very fast when you punch it and it runs great when you are not and just cruising. Shifting was immediately improved over stock tune with quicker shifts to higher rpm’s when you punch it and just smoother shifting when you are not and it’s not aggressive when you are cruising which makes running in the performance mode all the time (except when towing, as warnings not to tow in performance mode) nice. Wish I would have installed this a long time ago!
visible.product: Livernois Motorsports MyCalibrator Touch Tuner (11-14 3.5L EcoBoost F-150)
